## Implemented scope

sistema/api/isolated_login.py composes with PR10;tests/test_isolated_login.py and existing CI extended. Disabled by default;requires enable_test_login=True,loopback REMOTE_ADDR,isolated_test store marker and fixture-* identities. No automatic schema migration,account creation or listener. Headers cannot supply the trusted remote address. Do not expose through a proxy/tunnel:these are operational guardrails,not containment against malicious operators.

POST /api/v2/login accepts only JSON username/password,body1..4096bytes,password1..1024UTF8bytes,username lowercase ASCII1..80. Duplicate keys,extra fields,Origin,Transfer-Encoding and invalid types rejected. No cookies/CORS,no-store and redacted errors.

scrypt N=2^17,r=8,p=1,16byte salt,32byte digest,maxmem256MiB;hmac.compare_digest. [OWASP guidance](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Password_Storage_Cheat_Sheet.html) checked live. No new package dependency or CVE audit. Unknown/disabled users perform one KDF and return the same401body as a wrong password;whole-request timing equivalence not measured.

A BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction checks persisted global5attempts/60s budget,verifies password and inserts a900s session. Token generated with secrets.token_urlsafe(32),only SHA256persisted. All actual executions used temporary fictional accounts. Login never creates an AccessGrant:login alone still yields403on reading,until the test explicitly inserts its fictional grant. The test budget is coarse,not production distributed/per-user abuse control. It can block other fixture users and holds a write transaction through KDF work.

## Remaining limits

No real provisioning,reset,MFA,account UI,logout HTTP,grant issuance,acta verification or payments. Revocation tested via direct fixture update,not logout endpoint. No TLS,hostile concurrency,load,production audit logging or deployment configuration. Body size is bounded but host must impose socket/slow-body timeouts. Store,clock,WSGIenvironment and local filesystem administration are trusted. No response recall/distributed revocation/production timing guarantee. Existing grants and human gates remain mandatory. No changes to search,citations,export,OCR or legal validity.

This advances isolated account/session integration,not D09/M03 or pilot completion. Future production onboarding remains separately authorized work;do not turn this fixture-only login into a real identity service by flipping a flag.
